Budget: 20 uA tail and 80 uA second stage. gm1 about 120 uS with Cc = 1 pF gives GBW about 19 MHz. SR = Itail/Cc, about 20 V/us. gm7 about 0.8 mS puts p2 above 3x GBW. Gain is about 36 + 34 dB, about 70 dB."}

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (12.0, 8.0, 18.0),
    "L1":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),
    "Itail": (20e-6, 10e-6, 60e-6),
    "Lp":    (0.8, 0.5, 1.5),
    "I7":    (80e-6, 40e-6, 200e-6),
    "Cc":    (1.0e-12, 0.5e-12, 2.5e-12),
    "Ln":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "rz_k":  (1.5, 0.8, 3.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    It, I7, Cc = p["Itail"], p["I7"], p["Cc"]
    gmid_p = 10.0
    gmid_n = 9.0

    # Bias: ibias diode, tail and second-stage sinks all share L and gm/Id
    mb = lut.size("n", gmid_n, p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.65)
    mt = lut.size("n", gmid_n, p["Ln"], It, vds=0.25)
    m8 = lut.size("n", gmid_n, p["Ln"], I7, vds=0.9)

    # Input pair
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], It / 2, vds=0.5)

    # PMOS mirror load; M7 uses the same L and gm/Id for low systematic offset
    m3 = lut.size("p", gmid_p, p["Lp"], It / 2, vds=1.1)
    m7 = lut.size("p", gmid_p, p["Lp"], I7, vds=0.9)

    Rz = p["rz_k"] / m7.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    # M1 (diode side) is driven by vinn; M2 (output side) by vinp, for correct overall polarity
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "x", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "x", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    n.R("RZ", "x", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    # Predictions
    A1 = m1.gm / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = m7.gm / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    ugbw = m1.gm / (2 * PI * Cc)
    Cx = m7.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    Cout = cl + m7.cdd + m8.cdd
    p2 = m7.gm * Cc / (2 * PI * (Cout * Cc + Cx * (Cout + Cc)))
    pmir = m3.gm / (2 * PI * (2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd))
    z = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Cc * (1.0 / m7.gm - Rz))  # LHP zero when Rz > 1/gm7
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / pmir))
    if z < 0:
        pm += math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / abs(z)))
    slew = min(It / Cc, I7 / (cl + Cc))
    power = 1.8 * (iref + It + I7)

    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "slew": slew, "power": power}
```
